resources.string: Tips & Features
Discover useful features and shortcuts you may have missed
Got it!
1. Records & Lists
Create a New List from Selected Records

You can create a new list using only the records you select.

How:
Select the records → tap Bulk Actions → choose Cut Selected or Copy Selected → choose Create New List.

Cut moves the selected records to the new list.
Copy keeps the original records unchanged.
Move or Copy Records to Another List

Selected records can be transferred to another existing list.

How:
Select the records → tap Bulk Actions → choose Cut Selected or Copy Selected → select the destination list.

You don't need to enter the records again.
Minimize the Add Expenditure Form

If you want more space to view your records, you can hide the record-entry fields.

How:
Tap Minimize [-] in the Add Expenditure section.

Tap it again to show the fields.
Switch Between Expenses and Budget

A list can contain both Expenses and Budget records.

How:
Use the Expenses and Budget buttons near the top of the list to switch between them.
Organize Lists into Groups

You can place a list inside a Group to keep the Dashboard organized.

How:
Open the list options menu for the list you want to organize → choose Move to Group → select the destination Group.
Pin Frequently Used Lists and Groups

You can keep important lists and groups easier to access by pinning them.

How:
Tap the pin icon on a list or group.
Archive Old Lists and Groups

You can archive lists and groups to declutter your Dashboard. Archived items are read-only to prevent accidental changes.

How:
Long press a list or group and select Archive.

To view or unarchive them, tap the Archive icon at the top of the Dashboard.
2. Search, Filter & Sort
Tap a Date to See the Day

The date displayed in a record can show the day of the week temporarily.

How:
Tap the date in a record.

For example, 20–08–2026 can temporarily change to Thursday.

It automatically changes back after a few seconds.
Combine Search and Filters

Search and filters can be used together.

Example:
Search for Lunch and apply a Category or Date Range filter at the same time.

This helps narrow down a large list quickly. NoteCalc will also display the total number of matching records found.
Filter by Category
You can filter records based on their categories.
Filter by Date Range

You can display records from a specific date range.

How:
Open the date filter → select the From and To dates → tap Apply.
Filter by Amount Range

You can find records between two amounts.

Example:
Set the range from Rs100 to Rs500 to display records within that range.
Sort Records from the Column Headers

You can sort records directly from the table headers.

Tap S.No., Description, Date, or Amount.

Tap the same header again to switch between ascending and descending order.
Search Lists from the Dashboard
If your Dashboard contains many lists, use the search bar to find a list quickly.
Sort Lists from the Dashboard

Your Dashboard lists can also be sorted by:

Title
Total
Latest Modified

Tap the corresponding sorting option to change the order.
View Filter Results Count
When you apply a search query or filter, NoteCalc dynamically displays the total number of matching records that were found.
3. Bulk Actions
See the Count and Total of Selected Records

When records are selected, NoteCalc shows the number of selected records and their combined amount.

Where:
Look at the information displayed in the Bulk Actions/selection area after selecting records.
Export Only Selected Records

You don't have to export the entire list.

How:
Select the records → Bulk Actions → Export as PDF.

The PDF will contain only the selected records.
Delete Multiple Records Together

You can delete multiple selected records at once.

How:
Select the records → tap Bulk Actions → Delete Selected.

This is much faster than deleting records individually.
Filter by Category from Bulk Actions

The Bulk Actions menu also provides access to category filtering.

How:
Select one or more records → tap Bulk Actions → choose the category filter option.

This can be useful when you are already working with a group of selected records.
4. Attachments & PDF
Take a Photo Directly from NoteCalc

You can capture a photo without leaving NoteCalc.

How:
Tap Attach File → Take Photo.

The captured photo can then be attached to the record.
Attach Images, PDFs and Documents

You can attach supported files such as:

Images
PDF files
Word documents

You can also take a photo directly using the camera option.
Open an Attachment Directly

Attachments appear inside the record.

Tap an attachment to open it using an appropriate application on your device.

For multiple attachments, tap the attachment summary to reveal the individual files.
Remove an Attachment Before Saving

You can remove an attached file before saving the record.

How:
Tap the X beside the attachment you want to remove.
Images Are Added to a PDF Attachment Appendix
When a PDF contains records with image attachments, NoteCalc adds an Attachments Appendix containing those images.\n\nImages are arranged in a two-column layout with their filenames.
Other Attachments Are Listed in the PDF
PDF and document attachments are not inserted as their full document contents.\n\nTheir filenames are included with the corresponding record in the generated PDF.
Choose the PDF Sorting Order

Before exporting a PDF, you can choose how the records should be arranged.

Available options include:

S.No.
Description
Date
Amount
5. Backup & Personalization
Export a Complete Backup

You can create a backup of your NoteCalc data in JSON format.

How:
Go to Settings → Data & Backup → Export Backup (JSON).

Keep this file somewhere safe so you can restore your data later.
Restore Your NoteCalc Data

You can restore your data from a previously exported JSON backup.

How:
Go to Settings → Data & Backup → Import Backup (JSON).

Warning: Restoring a backup overwrites your current NoteCalc data.
Export All Lists to One PDF

You can create a PDF containing all your available records instead of exporting lists individually.

How:
Go to Settings → Data & Backup → Export All to PDF.
View What\'s New

You can view the latest features and changes added to NoteCalc.

How:
Go to Settings and tap on the App Version number at the bottom of the screen.
Export a Group to PDF

You can download all the lists inside a specific Group as a single combined PDF.

How:
Long-press on a Group in the Dashboard and select Export Group as PDF.
